description_en: Queries the list of computing resources that meet the specified business information
description_zh: 根据计算资源业务信息，查询符合的计算资源列表
name: ListComputeResources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the computing resource
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The filter for computing resource types. You can configure multiple types for filtering
parameters.help_zh: 计算资源类型查询过滤，可以配置多个类型查询过滤
parameters.name: types

parameters.help_en:
The environment type of the computing resource. Valid values:

Dev

Prod
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源环境类型，枚举值：
Dev：开发环境
Prod：生产环境
parameters.name: env_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. The default value is 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 查询第几页，默认值为1表示第一页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 10, and the maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值为10，最大值100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field to sort the computing resource list by. Supported fields include name, creation time, and computing resource ID.

CreateTime: Sorts by creation time

Id: Sorts by computing resource ID

Name: Sorts by computing resource name.

CreateTimeWithDefaultFirst: Sorts based on whether it is the default resource and by creation time, with the default computing resource listed first.

Default value: CreateTime
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源列表排序字段，支持名称、创建时间、计算资源ID排序

CreateTime：创建时间
Id：计算资源ID
Name：计算资源名称
CreateTimeWithDefaultFirst：基于默认与否和创建时间排序，默认计算资源排序在前

默认值：CreateTime
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort direction of the computing resource list. Valid values:

Desc: descending order.

Asc: ascending order.

Default value: Desc
parameters.help_zh:
计算资源列表排序方向，枚举值：

Desc：倒序
Asc：正序

默认值：Desc
parameters.name: order

ComputeResources.description_en: The list of computing resources. Each element is a computing resource group that contains information about the development environment (if any) and the production environment
ComputeResources.description_zh: 计算资源列表，每一个元素是一个计算资源组，包含开发环境（如有）和生产环境的信息

items.description_en: Information about the computing resource group, which includes computing resources for the development environment (if any) and the production environment. The computing resources for the development and production environments have the same name and type but different IDs
items.description_zh: 计算资源组信息，包含开发环境（如有）和生产环境的计算资源。开发环境和生产环境的计算资源具有相同的计算资源名称和计算资源类型，不相同的计算资源ID

ComputeResource.description_en: Details of a single computing resource

items.description_en: Details of a single computing resource

ConnectionProperties.description_en: The category of the added compute resource. Different types have different subtypes with corresponding parameter constraints. Examples: InstanceMode: The instance mode. UrlMode: The connection string mode
ConnectionProperties.description_zh:
计算资源添加的类别，不同type下会有不同的子类型，对应有不同的参数约束，场景举例：
InstanceMode 实例模式。
UrlMode 连接串模式

ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_en:
The specific connection configuration details for the computing resource, including the connection address, access identity, and environment information. envType, which specifies the computing resource environment, is a property of this object. Valid values:

Dev

Prod Different types of computing resources have different attribute specifications under different configuration modes (ConnectionPropertiesMode)
ConnectionPropertiesMode.description_zh:
计算资源的具体连接配置信息，包括连接地址、访问身份、环境信息等。计算资源环境envType信息是此对象的成员属性，包括
Dev（开发环境）
Prod（生产环境）
不同类型的计算资源在不同的配置模式（ConnectionPropertiesMode）下具有不同的属性信息规范

Description.description_en: The unique identifier of the computing resource
Description.description_zh: 计算资源ID，计算资源的唯一标识符

Id.description_en: The computing resource ID, which is the unique identifier for the resource
Id.description_zh: 计算资源ID，计算资源的唯一标识符

ModifyTime.description_en: The last modified time of the computing resource (timestamp)
ModifyTime.description_zh: 计算资源的最近修改时间（时间戳）

WhetherDefault.description_en: Specifies whether it is the default compute resource

Name.description_en: The name of the computing resource

Type.description_en: The type of the computing resource

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题
